title: Rabbi Avsumchos
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Sanhedrin chapter 3: he appeared with another man before Rabbi Elazar in a dispute over millstones and lost the case. After the final judgment, he brought witnesses supporting his claim. Rabbi Yochanan ruled that he could reopen the judgment.

notes.text: “After the final judgment” expands גמ״ד. Reopening the judgment on new witnesses is the ruling reported here; the notice does not say he immediately won a new verdict.
The consulted end of Yerushalmi Sanhedrin 3 supplies context about reopening judgments. Hyman’s particular millstone case remains unlocated in the passages checked.
